about: The 3-layer Inkling mini (L294) on its uniform K3 EXL3 pack: every attention / dense / shared / routed Linear exl3m_k3 and the head exl3m_k6 (the pack's, stored 201088 wide for 201024 logits; L295 F7) from --exl3, byte copies of the pack; norms, short convs, relative bases, router, scales, embed and the hmlp tower in their source dtype.
